package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	httpmw "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

type StudentRuntimeHandler struct {
	Students studentuc.StudentUseCase
}

func (handler StudentRuntimeHandler) GetRuntimeTask(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(request.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	item, err := handler.Students.GetRuntimeTask(
		request.Context(),
		chi.URLParam(request, "taskID"),
		studentID,
		request.URL.Query().Get("answer_id"),
	)
	if err != nil {
		writeRuntimeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, item)
}

func (handler StudentRuntimeHandler) GetRuntimeLesson(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(request.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	item, err := handler.Students.GetRuntimeLesson(request.Context(), chi.URLParam(request, "lessonID"), studentID)
	if err != nil {
		writeRuntimeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, item)
}

func (handler StudentRuntimeHandler) GetRuntimeTaskAccess(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(request.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	item, err := handler.Students.GetRuntimeTaskAccess(request.Context(), chi.URLParam(request, "taskID"), studentID)
	if err != nil {
		writeRuntimeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, item)
}

func (handler StudentRuntimeHandler) InternalGetRuntimeTask(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	item, err := handler.Students.GetRuntimeTask(
		request.Context(),
		chi.URLParam(request, "taskID"),
		request.URL.Query().Get("user_id"),
		request.URL.Query().Get("answer_id"),
	)
	if err != nil {
		writeRuntimeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, item)
}

func (handler StudentRuntimeHandler) InternalGetRuntimeLesson(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	item, err := handler.Students.GetRuntimeLesson(request.Context(), chi.URLParam(request, "lessonID"), request.URL.Query().Get("user_id"))
	if err != nil {
		writeRuntimeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, item)
}

func (handler StudentRuntimeHandler) BindRuntimeAnswer(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	var payload struct {
		StudentID  string  `json:"student_id"`
		SandboxID  string  `json:"sandbox_id"`
		PreviewURL *string `json:"preview_url"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		http.Error(responseWriter, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	var sandbox *domain.SandboxSession
	if payload.SandboxID != "" {
		sandbox = &domain.SandboxSession{SandboxID: payload.SandboxID}
		if payload.PreviewURL != nil {
			sandbox.PreviewURL = *payload.PreviewURL
		}
	}
	item, err := handler.Students.BindRuntimeAnswer(
		request.Context(),
		payload.StudentID,
		chi.URLParam(request, "taskID"),
		chi.URLParam(request, "answerID"),
		sandbox,
	)
	if err != nil {
		writeRuntimeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, item)
}

func (handler StudentRuntimeHandler) FinalizeRuntimeAnswer(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	var payload domain.RuntimeFinalizeInput
	if err := json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		http.Error(responseWriter, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	payload.AnswerID = chi.URLParam(request, "answerID")
	if err := handler.Students.FinalizeRuntimeAnswer(request.Context(), payload); err != nil {
		writeRuntimeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"status": "ok"})
}

func writeRuntimeError(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	var lockedErr *domain.MilestoneLockedError
	switch {
	case errors.As(err, &lockedErr):
		responseWriter.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		responseWriter.WriteHeader(http.StatusConflict)
		_ = json.NewEncoder(responseWriter).Encode(map[string]any{
			"code":                               "MILESTONE_LOCKED",
			"message":                            err.Error(),
			"blocking_reason":                    lockedErr.BlockingReason,
			"prerequisites":                      lockedErr.Prerequisites,
			"student_practice_task_id":           lockedErr.StudentPracticeTaskID,
			"student_practice_task_milestone_id": lockedErr.StudentPracticeTaskMilestoneID,
		})
	default:
		writeError(responseWriter, err)
	}
}
